thread:
sarah: deploy-bot flagged release v2.14.0 for SBOM vuln policy — canary is blocked. anyone triaging? I'm in a meeting for 20m.

deploy-bot: [automated] Release v2.14.0 scan result: 1 transitive CVE (HIGH) in baseimage: libc 2.31 -> policy: block-canary. link: https://ci.internal/reports/v2.14.0-sbom

raj: grabbing it. can you drop the SBOM snippet here?

emma: ping @raj — the alert shows libc from upstream base image. might be safe if patched upstream, but compliance wants pin or exception.

luke: short term options: 1) pin base image to digest + patch later, 2) rollback canary to v2.13, 3) request exception from compliance.

raj: looking at SBOM: ```
package: libc
version: 2.31
license: LGPL
source: docker.io/library/debian:10
cve: CVE-2021-XXXXX (HIGH)
```

oliver: compliance-bot: exception required for high CVE in base image. Provide mitigation timeline + rollout plan.

emma: can we do a digest pin to old patched image? CI shows no compatible patched image in our registry.

luke: if we pin to a digest we'll lose latest patches, risk other fixes. re: rollforward, patched upstream expected in 48-72h.

sarah: we need product decision — canary is small traffic (5%) but customer-facing. I'd prefer a controlled rollback to v2.13 and keep canary off until signoff.

raj: I can prepare rollback PR & deploy plan (1-2 devs, 20m) and notify support. will also open compliance exception if needed.

compliance-bot: Required fields for exception: affected_component, risk_assessment, mitigation_steps, estimated_remediation_date, approver(s). Use /compliance create.

oliver: filing exception now. tagging @legal for signoff.

luke: action: raj -> rollback plan, sarah -> confirm rollback window (now -> +30m?), oliver -> file exception, emma -> test rollback in staging.

sarah: ok rolling back canary in next 15m. raj, update this thread when PR is merged. :thumbsup: 

raj: PR merged at 1712004820, rollback deploy started at 1712004905. will post status.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback to v2.13 initiated by raj. job id: deploy-98765.

raj: rollback finished at 1712005020. canary traffic back to v2.13. monitoring ok so far.

emma: running smoke tests, all green.

oliver: exception created: EXC-2024-021. provisional approver: legal-team. next update when remediation ETA confirmed.

sarah: thanks everyone. reopen if we see regressions. closing thread for now.
